category: Preferences: System, Data Management, PCB Editor and Schematic pages
description: The pages of the Preferences dialog (gear icon / Tools > Preferences) that configure the environment: System, Data Management, PCB Editor and Schematic categories, plus the Advanced Settings feature flags. Preferences are global (per user), stored in the AppData profile and importable/exportable via the Preferences dialog's Save/Load/Import buttons.

tools.name: Preferences > System > General
tools.description: Startup behaviour (Reopen last project group, Open Home page, Show startup screen), General options (Monitor clipboard content for special format), Selection (Confirm Deselect All), Localization (Use localized resources, Display localized dialogs, Localized menus), and the Advanced button that opens the Advanced Settings list of feature flags.
tools.example: Disable 'Show startup screen' and enable 'Reopen last project group' for faster start-up.
tools.notes: Localization changes require a restart.

tools.name: Advanced Settings (feature flags)
tools.description: Searchable list of named boolean/value settings that enable optional or beta features and tune behaviour, e.g. PCB.Rules.RoutingNeckdown, PCB.Rules.ZAxisClearanceRule, PCB.SolderMaskZeroExpansion, UI.ProjectOptions.SearchPaths, System.ConstraintManager, System.HarnessDesignAvailable, System.ViewOnlyMode.Support, Legacy.PCB.PadStack (Legacy pad/via editing), UI.Unification.Preferences. Changes usually need a restart.
tools.usage: Preferences > System > General > Advanced... > filter by name > edit Value > OK > restart

parameters.name: Setting name
parameters.description: Dotted identifier grouped by area (PCB, Sch, System, UI, Legacy...).

tools.example: Set UI.ProjectOptions.SearchPaths = True to restore the Search Paths tab in Project Options.
tools.notes: Flags are release-specific; document which ones a project relies on since they are per user, not per project.

tools.name: Preferences > System > View
tools.description: Desktop layout options (Autosave desktop, Restore open documents, Exclude from autosave), Popup Panels (delay, hide delay, animation), Document tabs (grouping, multiline tabs, Ctrl+Tab switching), UI Theme (Altium Light Gray / Altium Dark Gray), General (Show full path in title bar, Show shadows), and Font settings for the UI.

parameters.name: Autosave desktop
parameters.description: Remember panel layout and open documents.

tools.example: Switch UI Theme to Altium Dark Gray and enable 'Show full path in title bar'.
tools.notes: Panel layouts can be saved/loaded with View > Desktop Layouts.

tools.name: Preferences > System > Navigation
tools.description: Highlight Methods used when cross-probing or navigating (Zoom, Select, Mask (Dim), Connective Graph) with zoom precision, plus Objects To Display when navigating (Pins, Net Labels, Ports, Sheet Entries, Power Objects, Sheet Symbols, Components) and Include Power Parts/Objects options. Governs behaviour of the Navigator panel, cross-probe and Alt+Click net highlighting.

parameters.name: Highlight Methods
parameters.description: Zoom | Select | Dim | Connective Graph and zoom precision.

tools.example: Enable Zoom and Dim, set precision 50%, so double-clicking a net in the Navigator dims everything else.
tools.notes: Cross Select Mode uses the Select method; Cross Probe uses Zoom.

tools.name: Preferences > System > Design Insight
tools.description: Controls document preview and connectivity pop-ups: Document Insight (preview on hover in Projects panel, delay), Connectivity Insight (show connective graph for nets/ports/net labels/sheet entries on hover, delay, opacity, graph settings), Hyperlinks (show for parameters/URLs) and which object kinds trigger the pop-up.
tools.example: Disable Connectivity Insight on slow machines to avoid the hover graph while wiring.
tools.notes: Board Insight (PCB) settings live under PCB Editor.

tools.name: Preferences > System > Projects Panel
tools.description: Projects panel display: General (Show open/modified status, Show VCS status, Show document position, Show full path, Show grid), Sorting (Project order, Name, Document kind, Ascending/Descending), Grouping (Do not group / By class / By document type), Default Expansion (Fully expanded, Only open documents, etc.), and Single Click options (Activate/Open documents on single click).

parameters.name: Show VCS status / Show document position

tools.example: Group by document type, sort by name, show VCS status to see modified files at a glance.
tools.notes: Structure view (Projects panel toolbar) shows the compiled hierarchy instead.

tools.name: Preferences > System > Default Locations
tools.description: Default folders for Document Path (new projects/documents), Library Path (base for relative library paths), OutputJob files and legacy templates, so File > New and library installation dialogs open in the right place and relative paths resolve consistently across machines.
tools.example: Set Library Path to D:\Altium\Libraries so the installed-library list can use relative paths shared via VCS.
tools.notes: Relative library paths in preferences are stored relative to this Library Path.

tools.name: Preferences > System > File Types
tools.description: Associates file extensions with Altium Designer (per version) so double-clicking .PrjPcb, .SchDoc, .PcbDoc, .IntLib etc. in Windows opens this installation; also used to hand extensions back to another version. Lists all document kinds with checkboxes and Select All/Deselect options.
tools.usage: Preferences > System > File Types > tick extensions > OK (may prompt for elevation)
tools.example: After installing AD25 alongside AD24, open File Types in AD25 and claim .PrjPcb/.SchDoc/.PcbDoc.
tools.notes: Windows may need the 'Default apps' setting confirmed for the .PrjPcb association.

tools.name: Preferences > System > New Document Defaults
tools.description: Lists document kinds (Schematic, PCB, Draftsman, OutJob, BOM, project types...) and the template applied when each is created via File > New; templates can be local files or Workspace templates managed in Data Management > Templates.
tools.usage: Preferences > System > New Document Defaults (or Data Management > Templates > set as default)

parameters.name: Template per document kind
parameters.description: File or managed template used by File > New.

tools.example: Set PCB default to 'Company_4L.PcbDot' so new boards start with the standard stack, rules and mechanical layer set.
tools.notes: Project templates cover a whole project (documents plus options).

tools.name: Preferences > System > Mouse Wheel Configuration
tools.description: Assigns actions to wheel and modifier combinations separately for schematic and PCB: Zoom Main Window, Vertical Scroll, Horizontal Scroll, Change Layer (PCB), plus Zoom on cursor position and wheel sensitivity, so users coming from other CAD tools can match their habits.
tools.example: Set plain Wheel = Zoom Main Window, Ctrl+Wheel = Vertical Scroll for KiCad-like behaviour.
tools.notes: Ctrl+Shift+Wheel is used for layer cycling during routing; keep it assigned to Change Layer.

tools.name: Preferences > System > Installation / Network Activity / Product Improvement
tools.description: Installation: automatic update checking, update location (Altium server or local network folder), installation service permissions; Network Activity: master toggle and per-service switches for cloud connectivity (Workspace, supplier data, updates, content) for offline/secure environments; Product Improvement: opt in/out of usage analytics.
tools.usage: Preferences > System > Installation | Network Activity | Product Improvement
tools.example: On an air-gapped workstation disable Network Activity entirely and point Installation to the local update folder.
tools.notes: Account Management (sign-in, licensing) is a separate System page.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Version Control
tools.description: Selects the SVN provider (built-in Subversion is installed by default) and Git, sets working copy format, Unicode file-name support and whether external SVN tools are used; repository connections themselves are defined under Design Repositories. Applies to the Storage Manager and Projects panel VCS commands.
tools.example: Enable Git, then add a repository under Design Repositories and use Projects panel > Version Control > Add to VCS.
tools.notes: Workspace projects use built-in Git behind the scenes and need no configuration here.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Servers
tools.description: Lists connected Workspaces/Altium Enterprise Servers with active connection toggle, and holds Project Release settings (release temp folder), Content Type definitions (lifecycle definition and revision naming scheme per content type: Component, Symbol, Footprint, Project, Template...) and operation permissions for the current user.

parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: Which Workspace is used by panels and release.

tools.example: Set the active Workspace to 'Company Prod' and verify Components use '2-Level Revision Scheme'.
tools.notes: Sign-in state is on System > Account Management.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Publishing Destinations
tools.description: Defines targets for the Project Releaser / Publish To output containers: Amazon S3 buckets, Box.com, FTP servers and local/network folders with credentials and paths, so released fabrication/assembly packages can be published automatically.
tools.usage: Preferences > Data Management > Publishing Destinations > Add (Folder | FTP | Box | Amazon S3)
tools.example: Add FTP destination 'Fab house' and select it in the OutJob's Publish To container.
tools.notes: Altium 365 Manufacturing Package sharing is a separate mechanism.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Backup / Local History / File Locking
tools.description: Backup: Auto save every N minutes, number of versions to keep, backup path. Local History: keep document versions for N days, storage global or per project, enabling right-click Local History on any document to revert. File Locking: warn when a document is opened in another Altium instance/user (advisory locks).
tools.usage: Preferences > Data Management > Backup | Local History | File Locking
tools.example: Auto save every 10 min keeping 5 versions; Local History 30 days per project so reverting a schematic is possible without VCS.
tools.notes: Backups are in the History/Backup subfolders; they are not a substitute for version control.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Templates
tools.description: Central template management: lists local and Workspace templates by kind (Schematic, PCB, Draftsman, Project, OutJob, BOM, Component templates), with Set as Default, Edit, Upload to Workspace, Migrate and Refresh, and a switch for using Workspace templates when connected. Drives File > New defaults and Design > Templates lists.

parameters.name: Default per kind
parameters.description: Template used by New Document Defaults.

tools.example: Upload A3_Company.SchDot to the Workspace and set it as the default schematic template for the team.
tools.notes: Managed templates are revisioned; consuming documents can be updated to the latest revision.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Parts Providers
tools.description: Configures supplier data used by the Manufacturer Part Search panel, ActiveBOM and supply-chain parameters: enabled Locations/regions, currencies, suppliers (Digi-Key, Mouser, Farnell, Arrow, TTI...), and Parameter Import Options (which supplier fields become component parameters, e.g. Supplier, Supplier Part Number, Unit Price).

parameters.name: Suppliers / Currencies
parameters.description: Filter of offers displayed and ranked.

parameters.name: Parameter Import Options
parameters.description: Fields added to components on Acquire.

tools.example: Enable only Digi-Key and Mouser in EUR so ActiveBOM solutions rank against your purchasing channels.
tools.notes: Requires Network Activity for supplier services.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Component Types / Component Rule Checks / Dictionaries
tools.description: Component Types: the hierarchy of component types (Capacitors, Resistors, ICs...) with assigned component templates and Workspace folders, merge/rename operations. Component Rule Checks: severity of checks run before releasing a managed component (missing symbol/footprint, duplicate parameters, naming). Dictionaries: administrator access to parameter dictionaries (units, enumerations) used by component templates.
tools.usage: Preferences > Data Management > Component Types | Component Rule Checks | Dictionaries

parameters.name: Type -> Template / Folder
parameters.description: Defaults for new managed components of each type.

tools.example: Set 'Component has no footprint' = Error so Batch Component Editing refuses to release incomplete parts.
tools.notes: Requires Workspace administrator rights to edit.

tools.name: Preferences > Data Management > Device Sheets / SVN Libraries
tools.description: Device Sheets: global folders of reusable device sheets (with Include Sub-folders), read-only flag and watermark display options (e.g. 'Device Sheet' watermark colour); SVN Libraries: working folder for editing SVN database library symbols/footprints and cache refresh settings.
tools.usage: Preferences > Data Management > Device Sheets | SVN Libraries

parameters.name: Device sheet folders
parameters.description: Locations offered by Place > Device Sheet Symbol.

parameters.name: Editing working folder
parameters.description: Local checkout for SVNDbLib model edits.

tools.example: Add \\server\Altium\DeviceSheets with sub-folders, keep 'Device sheets are read-only' enabled.
tools.notes: Project Options > Device Sheets adds project-specific folders.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > General
tools.description: Editing Options (Online DRC, Snap To Center, Smart Component Snap, Remove Duplicates, Confirm Global Edit, Protect Locked Objects, Confirm Selection Memory Clear, Click Clears Selection, Shift Click To Select, Smart Track Ends, Display popup selection dialog), Autopan Options (style, speed), Space Navigator, Polygon Rebuild (Repour Polygons After Modification, Repour all dependent polygons), File Format Change Report, Paste from other applications, Collaboration and Rotation Step, Cursor Type, Comp Drag (Move only / Move and connected tracks).

parameters.name: Online DRC
parameters.description: Master switch for live rule checking.

tools.example: Set Rotation Step 45, Repour Polygons After Modification = Always, enable Protect Locked Objects.
tools.notes: Smart Component Snap snaps to the nearest pad when picking up a component.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Display
tools.description: Display Options (Antialiasing, Use animation for zoom/layer switching), Highlighting Options (Highlight in Full, Use Transparent Mode When Masking, Show All Primitives In Highlighted Nets, Apply Mask During Interactive Editing, Apply Highlight During Interactive Editing), Layer Drawing Order (which layers draw on top) and Default PCB View Configurations for 2D/3D.
tools.example: Move Top Overlay above Top Layer in the drawing order and enable 'Show All Primitives In Highlighted Nets'.
tools.notes: Antialiasing off improves performance on large boards.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Board Insight Display
tools.description: Pad and Via Display Options (Use Smart Display Color, Font, Min/Max font size, background, show pad nets/numbers, via nets), Available Single Layer Modes (Hide Other Layers, Gray Scale Other Layers, Monochrome Other Layers), Live Highlighting (enable, Outline only, only when Shift is held), and Show Locked Texture on Objects.
tools.usage: Preferences > PCB Editor > Board Insight Display
tools.example: Enable Gray Scale and Monochrome single-layer modes; enable Live Highlighting only when Shift is held.
tools.notes: Pad net/number display thresholds prevent clutter when zoomed out.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Board Insight Modes
tools.description: Heads Up Display settings: Display Heads Up Information, Use Background, Insert Key Resets Heads Up Delta Origin, Mouse Click Changes Heads Up Delta Origin, Hover Mode delay and opacity, and the information grid choosing which items (Cursor Location, Last Click Delta, Current Layer, Snap Grid, Summary of objects under cursor, Heads Up Preview, violation details) appear in the HUD and hover pop-up with fonts/colours.
tools.usage: Preferences > PCB Editor > Board Insight Modes

parameters.name: Information grid
parameters.description: Visible items in HUD and hover mode.

tools.example: Show Cursor Location, Current Layer and Last Click Delta in the HUD; enable Hover mode with 0.5 s delay for object details.
tools.notes: Insert key resets the delta origin for quick relative measurements.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Board Insight Color Overrides / DRC Violations Display
tools.description: Color Overrides: base pattern (solid, checkerboard, stripes) for net colour overrides and behaviour when zoomed out (pattern scaling, layer colour dominates, override colour dominates). DRC Violations Display: violation overlay style (None, Solid, Style A/B patterns), zoom-out behaviour, and a per-rule table selecting Violation Overlay and Violation Details display for each rule type.
tools.usage: Preferences > PCB Editor > Board Insight Color Overrides | DRC Violations Display

parameters.name: Overlay style
parameters.description: None | Solid | Pattern A | Pattern B.

parameters.name: Per-rule display
parameters.description: Overlay and detail markers per rule type.

tools.example: Use Solid overlays and enable Violation Details for Clearance and Width to see the measured gap on hover.
tools.notes: Violation markers require Create Violations in the DRC dialog.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Gloss And Retrace
tools.description: Parameters for automatic glossing during interactive routing and sliding (Gloss Effort defaults, corner handling, pad entry, arc/mitre rules) and separate Retrace parameters applied by Route > Retrace Selected (re-width, re-gap for diff pairs, keep or replace arcs), with sliders and reset to defaults.
tools.usage: Preferences > PCB Editor > Gloss And Retrace

parameters.name: Glossing parameters
parameters.description: Applied during routing/sliding and Gloss Selected.

tools.example: Reduce glossing aggressiveness for RF boards so mitred bends are preserved.
tools.notes: Shift+Ctrl+G cycles the routed gloss effort live.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > True Type Fonts
tools.description: Embed TrueType fonts in PCB documents (so text renders identically elsewhere) and choose the substitution font when a used font is unavailable on the machine; affects silkscreen/copper TrueType strings, barcodes and Gerber rendering of TrueType text (rasterised to regions at output).
tools.usage: Preferences > PCB Editor > True Type Fonts

parameters.name: Embed TrueType fonts inside PCB documents

tools.example: Enable embedding and set substitution to Arial for boards sent to contractors.
tools.notes: Stroke fonts (Default, Sans Serif, Serif) are safest for silkscreen legibility.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Defaults
tools.description: Default property values for every PCB primitive type (Arc, Component, Coordinate, Dimension variants, Fill, Pad, Polygon, Region, String, Track, Via, 3D body, Room...) used when placing new objects: layer, width, sizes, hole, mask expansion mode, font. Options: Permanent (lock defaults so Tab-edits do not change them), Save As / Load defaults file (.dft), Reset to defaults.
tools.usage: Preferences > PCB Editor > Defaults > select primitive > edit values; Permanent checkbox

parameters.name: Primitive list
parameters.description: Object kind whose defaults are edited.

parameters.name: Permanent
parameters.description: Prevent in-command changes from updating defaults.

tools.example: Set String default to Stroke Sans Serif, Height 1 mm, Width 0.15 mm, layer Top Overlay.
tools.notes: Via default size/hole here is overridden by Routing Via Style rules during routing.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Reports
tools.description: Checklist of PCB reports with Generate (TXT/HTML) and Show (open after generation) options: Design Rule Check, Net Status, Board Information, BGA Escape Route, Stackup analysis reports, Layer Stack Report, Testpoint Report, etc.; determines where report files go and whether they auto-open.
tools.example: Set Design Rule Check to HTML and Show so the report opens after each batch DRC.
tools.notes: Reports land in the project output folder.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Layer Colors
tools.description: Saved colour profiles for 2D layer colours (Default, Classic, Altium Standard, DXP 2004 and user-defined), each mapping every layer/system colour; Save As/Load/Delete profiles and apply to the current document via the View Configuration panel.
tools.usage: Preferences > PCB Editor > Layer Colors > select profile > Save As; View Configuration > Layer colour profile
tools.example: Create 'Print friendly' profile with dark colours on white background for documentation screenshots.
tools.notes: Per-document colours are stored in the PcbDoc; profiles are just presets.

tools.name: Preferences > PCB Editor > Models
tools.description: Model Search Path list scanned for STEP/Parasolid files referenced by name from 3D bodies, and temporary mesh/model data storage (directory, auto-clean interval), used when footprints link rather than embed models.

parameters.name: Model Search Path
parameters.description: Folders (with sub-folders) for linked 3D model files.

tools.example: Add D:\Altium\STEP so linked models in older libraries resolve after moving the library folder.
tools.notes: Embedding models in the PcbLib avoids path problems entirely.

tools.name: Preferences > Schematic > General
tools.description: Options (Break Wires At Autojunctions, Optimize Wires & Buses, Components Cut Wires, Enable In-Place Editing, Convert Cross-Junctions, Display Cross-Overs, Pin Direction, Sheet Entry Direction, Port Direction, Unconnected Left To Right, Drag Orthogonal), Include with Clipboard (No-ERC Markers, Parameter Sets, Notes), Alpha Numeric Suffix for multi-part (Alpha/Numeric/Alpha with separator), Pin Margin (Name/Number), Auto-Increment During Placement (Primary/Secondary, Remove Leading Zeroes), Default Power Object Names (Power Ground GND, Signal Ground SGND, Earth EARTH), Document scope for filtering and selection, Default Blank Sheet Size.

parameters.name: Default Power Object Names
parameters.description: Net names for GND/SGND/EARTH power ports.

tools.example: Set Alpha Numeric Suffix = Alpha, Primary auto-increment 1, Secondary 1, and Default Blank Sheet Size A3.
tools.notes: Document scope selection affects SCH Filter's Whole Project behaviour.

tools.name: Preferences > Schematic > Graphical Editing
tools.description: Options: Clipboard Reference (prompt for reference point on copy), Add Template to Clipboard, Display Names of Special Strings that have No Value Defined, Center of Object (moving by centre or hotspot), Object's Electrical Hot Spot, Auto Zoom, Single '\' Negation, Confirm Selection Memory Clear, Mark Manual Parameters, Always Drag (Ctrl to move), Click Clears Selection, Shift Click To Select, Protect Locked Objects, Reset Parts Designators On Paste; Auto Pan Options (Auto Pan Fixed Jump / Recenter, step size, shift step), Undo/Redo stack size, Colour Options (Selection colour), Cursor type (Large Cursor 90 / Small Cursor 45 / Tiny Cursor 45 / Small Cursor 90).

parameters.name: Always Drag
parameters.description: Dragging keeps wires attached; hold Ctrl to move without.

tools.example: Enable Always Drag, Reset Parts Designators On Paste and Large Cursor 90 for alignment.
tools.notes: Protect Locked Objects prevents accidental moves of locked title blocks.

tools.name: Preferences > Schematic > Compiler
tools.description: Compiled-view display options: Errors & Warnings (display, colour per level: Fatal Error, Error, Warning), Auto-Junctions (display on wires/buses, size, colour), Manual Junction Connection Status, Compiled Names Expansion (display expanded names for Designators, Net Labels, Ports, Sheet Numbers, Document Numbers on compiled tabs) with expansion behaviour (Never/Always/on compiled document).

parameters.name: Auto-Junctions display
parameters.description: Size and colour of junction dots.

parameters.name: Compiled Names Expansion
parameters.description: Show physical designators (U1_2) on compiled sheets.

tools.example: Enable Display expanded names for Designators so multi-channel compiled tabs show R1_1, R1_2.
tools.notes: Auto-junction size affects printed output legibility.

tools.name: Preferences > Schematic > AutoFocus / Library AutoZoom
tools.description: AutoFocus: dim unconnected objects (on Place, Move, Edit Graphically) and thicken connected objects with delay settings, plus Zoom Connected Objects when placing/moving. Library AutoZoom: behaviour when browsing library components (Do Not Change Zoom, Remember Last Zoom, Center Each Component with zoom precision).

parameters.name: Dim Unconnected Objects / Thicken Connected Objects
Library AutoZoom mode
parameters.description: Zoom behaviour in the library editor.

tools.example: Enable Thicken Connected Objects on Move with 500 ms delay; set Library AutoZoom to Center Each Component.
tools.notes: AutoFocus can be distracting on dense sheets; disable the dim option if so.

tools.name: Preferences > Schematic > Grids
tools.description: Grid Options (Visible Grid style Line/Dot, colour) and preset lists for Imperial (Snap 10/5/1, Electrical 4/2/1, Visible 10/5) and Metric grids (Snap 1/0.5/0.25 mm ...) that the G shortcut cycles through; each preset row holds Snap Grid, Snap Distance (electrical) and Visible Grid values.
tools.example: Keep Snap 10 (100 mil) as the first imperial preset so G returns to the standard grid; add Snap 5 for fine text placement.
tools.notes: Placing parts off the 100 mil grid causes 'Off-grid object' warnings and unconnected pins.

tools.name: Preferences > Schematic > Break Wire
tools.description: Behaviour of Edit > Break Wire: Cutting Length (Snap To Segment, Snap Grid Size Multiple, Fixed Length), Show Cutter Box (Never/Always/On Wire), Show Extremity Markers (Never/Always/On Wire).

parameters.name: Cutting Length
parameters.description: Snap To Segment | Snap Grid Size Multiple | Fixed Length.

tools.example: Set Cutting Length = Snap Grid Size Multiple 2 so one click removes exactly 200 mil of wire.
tools.notes: Break Wire is under Edit > Break Wire (E W).

tools.name: Preferences > Schematic > Defaults (Default Primitives)
tools.description: Default properties for each schematic primitive (Arc, Bezier, Bus, Bus Entry, Designator, Ellipse, Harness objects, Image, Junction, Line, Net Label, Note, Parameter, Part, Pin, Polygon, Port, Power Port, Probe, Rectangle, Sheet Entry, Sheet Symbol, Text Frame, Text String, Wire, No ERC, Parameter Set...) grouped by Primitives category (All, Wiring Objects, Drawing Objects, Sheet Symbol Objects, Harness Objects, Library Objects, Other); with Permanent lock, Save As/Load (.dft) and Reset options.
tools.usage: Preferences > Schematic > Defaults > select primitive > edit properties

parameters.name: Primitive
parameters.description: Object kind whose defaults are edited.

parameters.name: Permanent
parameters.description: Lock defaults against in-place Tab edits.

tools.example: Set Wire default colour to dark blue, Small width; Net Label font Arial 10; Port style Left & Right with width 60.
tools.notes: Pin defaults (length 30, electrical type Passive) apply in the library editor.

tools.name: Preferences > Draftsman / Harness Design / CAM Editor / Text Editors pages
tools.description: Other preference categories: Draftsman (General: default units, templates, line/arrow/font defaults, update behaviour; Primitives defaults), Harness Design (wiring diagram and layout drawing defaults, default wire/cable properties), CAM Editor (General, Miscellaneous, Import/Export defaults for the CAMtastic editor), Text Editors (syntax colours, tabs for script/netlist editing), Simulation (dashboard defaults) and Importers/Exporters (settings for DXF/DWG, IDF, OrCAD, PADS, Eagle, KiCad importers).
tools.usage: Preferences > Draftsman | Harness Design | CAM Editor | Text Editors | Importers/Exporters
tools.example: Draftsman > General: set units mm, default template Company_Fab_Assy, arrow style Closed Filled.
tools.notes: Importers/Exporters pages define default layer mappings for DXF export used by the OutJob.

tools.name: Preferences dialog: Save / Load / Import / Set To Default
tools.description: Toolbar of the Preferences dialog: Save (export all preferences to a .DXPPrf file), Load (import a .DXPPrf), Import From (pull preferences from a previous Altium version installed on the machine), Set To Defaults (current page, or Default All), plus a search box to filter pages. Used to roll out standard settings to a team or migrate after upgrading.
tools.usage: Preferences (gear icon or Tools > Preferences) > Save / Load / Import From / Set To Defaults
tools.example: Export 'Company_AD25.DXPPrf' from a configured workstation and Load it on every new installation.
tools.notes: Preferences also live under %AppData%\Altium\Altium Designer <GUID>\DXP.RCS; the dialog is the supported way to copy them.
